behavior: Serialize successful completion and READY replay by video with one PostgreSQL transaction advisory lock.
Re-read original status under the lock and compare status plus version before activation; an older completion cannot replace a newer active or READY version.
When a historical stale READY row is observed, mark it SUPERSEDED and refuse to enqueue it; only repair a missing active pointer when no newer version exists.
Create the encode job in the same database transaction as READY promotion and pointer activation, while READY replay still repairs legacy rows that have no job.
If an UPLOADING version loses to a newer READY version, mark it SUPERSEDED and remove its completed object from storage.
